title_ar: الشيخ الددو يختتم برنامجه العلمي والدعوي الصيفي لهذا العام بأربع محاضرات علمية،
title_en: Sheikh al-Dedew Concludes This Year's Summer Scholarly and Da'wah Programme with Four Scholarly Lectures
body_ar: اختتم فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن ولد الددو برنامجه العلمي والدعوي الصيفي لهذا العام بأربع محاضرات علمية، شهدت حضورا وإقبالا واسعا من سكان مدينة انواذيبو واستفاد منها جمع غفير من العلماء والدعاة وطلبة العلم من الجنسين.واستهل الشيخ برنامجه بمحاضرة بعنوان "مكانة العلم وفضل تعلمه وتعليمه" احتضنها مركز الجودة للعلوم الشرعية بين فيها فضيلته منزلة العلم الشرعي وفضل أهله وأهمية الإخلاص في طلبه وتعليمه داعيا سكان المدينة إلى تشجيع طلب العلم ودعم مؤسساته ورعايتها فالعلم أساس نهضة الأمة وصلاحها.أما المحاضرة الثانية، فجاءت بعنوان "عوامل صلاح المجتمعات ومحاربة الفساد والإفساد"، وتناول فيها الأسباب التي تؤدي إلى استقامة المجتمعات، وفي مقدمتها ترسيخ الإيمان، وإقامة العدل، والأمر بالمعروف والنهي عن المنكر، محذرا من آثار الفساد والإفساد على الأفراد والأمم معددا نماذج من العادات والأخلاق السيئة التي من واجب المجتمع محاربتها والتصدي لها كالمعاصي وتعاطي المخدرات والظلم وأكل المال العالم وعدم أداء الحقوق والأمانات.وافتتح الشيخ برنامج اليوم الثاني برقية شرعية احتضنها جامع قباء شهدت حضورا كبيرا من سكان المدينة قبل أن يلقي بعد عصر الأربعاء محاضرته الثالثة بعنوان "بلغوا عني ولو آية" في مسجد الرضوان بمدينة نواذيبو والتي كانت ضمن أنشطة النفير الدعوي 2026مـ الذي تنظمه جمعية المستقبل للدعوة والثقافة والتعليم حيث تحدث عن مقتضيات شهادة التوحيد، ووسائل الدعوة إلى الله ومسؤولية كل مسلم في تبليغ دين الله بحسب استطاعته كما حث على مواجهة شياطين الإنس والجن من خلال نشر الخير وترغيب الناس في الدعوة إلى الله والتمسك بالكتاب والسنة.واختُتمت أنشطة البرنامج بمحاضرة بعنوان "العمل الثقافي دعوة وعبادة" نظمتها جمعيتا شبيبة بناء الوطن والفتاة للتوعية والتربية تناول فيها _ فضيلته _ مكانة الشباب ودورهم المحوري في توعية المجتمع وإصلاحه وبناء الأوطان مؤكدا أن العمل الثقافي الهادف يعد من وسائل الدعوة إلى الله وخدمة الدين والمجتمع إذا أُخلصت فيه النية وحسن القصد.كما شمل البرنامج زيارات بعض العلماء والدعاة، إلى جانب استقبال فضيلة الشيخ في محل إقامته عشرات الشخصيات العلمية والدعوية، ومجموعات من أطر المدينة ووجهائها وسكانها، حيث جرت لقاءات علمية ودعوية تناولت قضايا الفكر والدعوة والتربية والحث على رعاية طلبة العلم واختُتمت بالدعاء بالتوفيق والسداد وأن يصلح الحال والمآل.
body_en: His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew concluded this year's summer scholarly and da'wah programme with four scholarly lectures, which saw a wide attendance and turnout from the people of the city of Nouadhibou, and from which a great throng of scholars, callers to Islam and students of knowledge of both sexes benefited. The Sheikh began his programme with a lecture entitled "The Standing of Knowledge and the Merit of Learning and Teaching It", hosted by the al-Jawdah Centre for the Sharia Sciences, in which His Eminence set out the rank of Sharia knowledge, the merit of its people, and the importance of sincerity (ikhlāṣ) in seeking and teaching it, calling on the people of the city to encourage the seeking of knowledge and to support and care for its institutions — for knowledge is the foundation of the Ummah's renaissance and its soundness. As for the second lecture, it came under the title "The Factors of the Soundness of Societies and the Combating of Corruption and of Corrupting", in which he took up the causes that lead to the uprightness of societies — foremost among them the establishing of faith, the setting up of justice, and enjoining right and forbidding wrong — warning of the effects of corruption and of corrupting upon individuals and nations, and enumerating examples of the bad customs and characters that it is the community's duty to combat and to stand against, such as acts of disobedience, the taking of narcotics, wrongdoing, consuming the wealth of others, and not discharging rights and trusts. The Sheikh opened the second day's programme with a Sharia session hosted by the Quba congregational mosque, which saw a large attendance from the people of the city, before delivering, after the afternoon prayer on Wednesday, his third lecture, entitled "Convey from me, even a single verse", at the al-Ridwan mosque in the city of Nouadhibou — which was among the activities of the 2026 Da'wah Mobilisation organised by the al-Mustaqbal Association for Da'wah, Culture and Education — where he spoke about what the testimony of God's oneness requires, the means of calling people to God, and the responsibility of every Muslim to convey the religion of God according to his capacity; and he urged the confronting of the devils among humankind and among the jinn by spreading what is good and making people desire to call others to God and to hold fast to the Book and the sunnah. The programme's activities were concluded with a lecture entitled "Cultural Work as Da'wah and as Worship", organised by the two associations Shabibat Bina' al-Watan and al-Fatat for Awareness and Upbringing, in which His Eminence took up the standing of the young and their pivotal role in making society aware, in reforming it and in building nations — affirming that purposeful cultural work is reckoned among the means of calling people to God and of serving religion and society, if the intention in it is kept sincere and the purpose is sound. The programme also took in visits to some of the scholars and callers to Islam, as well as His Eminence the Sheikh's receiving, at his place of residence, dozens of scholarly and da'wah figures, and groups of the city's professionals, its notables and its people, in which scholarly and da'wah meetings took place that took up questions of thought, of da'wah and of upbringing, and the urging of care for students of knowledge; and they were concluded with a supplication for success and right direction, and that God set right both the present state and the end.

flags.note: barqiyyah normally means a telegram, which makes no sense of an event hosted by a mosque and attended by a large crowd. It is most likely used here in the Mauritanian sense of a brief address or bulletin, or else it is a misprint for a related word. The recommendation is therefore option 2 rather than the literal option 1, and the English as written uses the more neutral 'session'. The Sheikh's office should say what was meant.

flags.context: in the list of bad customs the community must combat
options: read as أكل مال العالم / أموال الناس, 'consuming the wealth of others'
read as أكل المال الحرام, 'consuming unlawful wealth'
mark the phrase as defective and untranslated
flags.note: The Arabic as served is not grammatical: a definite noun followed by a second definite noun in apposition where a genitive construction is required. The likeliest intended sense is the well-known prohibition on consuming other people's property wrongfully. body_ar preserves the defect and the English reads the minimal repair, per style guide section 11.

flags.context: the announced title of the third lecture
options: Convey from me, even a single verse
Transmit from me, even one verse
Pass on from me, though it be a single verse
flags.note: A well-known hadith used here as a lecture title. No narrator, collection or grading is given in the record and none has been added. آية is 'verse' of the Qur'an here rather than 'sign'.

translator_notes: A news report by the site's news desk summarising four lectures. The content is the desk's summary of what the Sheikh said.

النفير الدعوي 2026 is the name of an organised campaign; rendered 'the 2026 Da'wah Mobilisation'. نفير is a summons to turn out in force, with a martial background, which the English keeps at 'mobilisation' without sharpening it.

The two associations' names are given as they stand, since translating them would invent English names they may not use: Shabibat Bina' al-Watan (the youth of nation-building) and al-Fatat for Awareness and Upbringing, the latter also appearing at record 1327.
واختُتمت carries a damma inside the word in two places in the source; preserved in body_ar. The tatweel used as a dash after 2026م is likewise preserved.
The underscores around _ فضيلته _ are the source's own punctuation and are preserved in body_ar.
Records 1394 and 1396 are stamped seventeen minutes apart on the evening of 25 July 2026 and report a programme that ran earlier that month; this is a batch upload, so date_is_cms_upload is true.
من الجنسين is rendered 'of both sexes' as the Arabic has it; the report is noting that women attended.
